responsibility: This definition module declares simple debugging helpers for GNU Modula-2 libraries, centered on location-aware halting and debug-string output. It belongs to the runtime diagnostics support layer and exports Halt for emitting Module:Function:Line:Message style failures plus DebugString for writing escaped text to the debugging output device.
same_name_distinction: Definition half of the Debug pair: it publishes the Halt and DebugString interfaces, while Debug.mod implements the actual formatted output, escape interpretation, and terminating halt behavior.
